P1.reason: B separates move legality, line detection, game end and winning into nameable rules; A lumps all end-of-game logic into one large group and mixes legality with cell updates.

differences.reason: Hurts: merges rows, columns, lines, full-board, termination and goals into one undifferentiated blob.
Hurts somewhat: links marking legality with its effects, but duplicates C1's cell updates and muddles the rule.
Helps: clean 'legal moves' rule, marking a blank cell or passing when not in control.
Helps: 'three in a line' is a natural rule a player would name.
Helps: clear 'when the game ends' rule.
Neutral to slight hurt: row definition alone is fragmentary; could join the line rule.
Neutral to slight hurt: column definition alone is fragmentary; could join the line rule.
Slight hurt: 'open board' helper isolated from the termination rule it serves.
